subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw officially own and release a status-only Wear OS companion that uses the paired Android phone's existing authenticated runtime?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but adding a native form factor, package/versioning scheme, CI lanes, dependencies, and compatibility surface is a product and ownership commitment that requires Android maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor status-only Wear
options.body: Approve the credential-free phone-first status slice as the initial official Wear boundary, subject to rebase and exact-head release proof.

options.title: Defer official Wear support
options.body: Keep Wear OS outside the official app until Android ownership and release capacity are explicitly allocated.

options.title: Review one Wear program
options.body: Pause this PR and evaluate it together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108997, accepting the larger combined product and compatibility scope.

recommendation.title: Sponsor status-only Wear
recommendation.body: Approve the credential-free phone-first status slice as the initial official Wear boundary, subject to rebase and exact-head release proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository's Android README explicitly names @obviyus as the Android app maintainer. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/apps/android/README.md?utm_source=openai))
